title: DND: PH does not need Beijing’s permission on defense ties

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of National Defense (DND) on Friday said China has no right to dictate the Philippines’ choice of defense partners following Beijing’s remarks on Manila’s recently signed defense agreement with Australia. “China has neither the right nor the moral basis to dictate to the Philippines how and with whom we cooperate to defend our sovereignty and national interests,” DND spokesperson Assistant Secretary Arsenio Andolong said in a statement. “We do not need Beijing’s permission regarding our relations with other nations, especially on matters of our defense and security,” he added.
